desk: Week 5 broke both of last issue's headlines. Zygon, the only unbeaten team, lost the Match of the Week to C33DeezNutzz, and Painty69, the only winless team, beat Hades9mm. Zygon and Johnny4Skins now share the top at 4-1. The rest of the week belonged to StealingGas: a perfect lineup, 202.54 with nothing left on the bench, the best score in the league and a 114.4-point win over YesChef23.

MAXPF, the points each week's best possible lineup would have scored, added up, sets the 2027 rookie draft order, which is why a perfect week is not all good news. StealingGas's best lineup is now worth more, his slot slid from the 1.03 to the 1.04, and YesChef23 holds the 1.03. At the top, Darkspaces set a second straight perfect lineup, 140.36 with nothing left on the bench, and lost again, this time by 23.2 to Johnny4Skins. He holds the 1.01 by 7.06 points of MAXPF over Snipe58. No block player has moved, and the chat spent the week on food poisoning, a gif of a nuclear bomb, and a commissioner who says his IR slot is staying put.

Johnny4Skins left 27.3 on the bench and still won by 23.2. StealingGas said he would trade for Maye now, and Darkspaces answered with a gif of a nuclear bomb.
drama.desk: Two perfect lineups, two losses, and the 1.01 by 7.06 points. The commissioner is running the best process in the league and the worst luck.

drama.h: The Block Stays Open, the Chat Keeps Shopping
drama.p: Zygon asked about Achane and offered about tree fiddy. Darkspaces said Achane is going to sit in his IR slot until next year. Zygon also asked about Swift, and StealingGas said he might be interested in the Swift sweepstakes too. Nothing cleared.
drama.desk: Three bidders, one seller, and no deal. Whoever keeps waiting will find the price after the deadline.
